content: Free-tier LLM APIs (e.g., Gemini free tier) are not reliable enough to be a sole production dependency: low RPM (5-15), daily request caps (100-1000 RPD), and tiers/quotas have been cut before (e.g., Dec 2025 Gemini free-tier reduction) without notice. Production systems relying on free tier for cost savings are most exposed; need graceful degradation/backoff/queueing (Oban retries) rather than assuming availability.
